method: Independent current direct HTTP byte capture with redirects, status, media type, byte count and SHA-256; signed-in browser rendering for the Houlihan Lokey page whose origin returned an Incapsula bootstrap to the command-line client; claim-level review of the current Ridgewood, Macquarie, Dauntless, FMCSA, Sweetspot and Evergreen pages

verifiedClaims: Ridgewood's current direct release, dated 2026-06-10, says Ridgewood acquired Dauntless Air, an aerial-firefighting emergency-management infrastructure company
The release says Dauntless deploys Fire Boss aircraft, trained personnel and support equipment under long-term government contracts and that existing management would continue after the acquisition

The release says transaction terms were not disclosed and omits the legal investee, direct holder, Ridgewood fund or vehicle, security, stake, votes, governance, control, complete seller set and rollover terms
The current rendered Houlihan Lokey transaction page says Ridgewood Infrastructure acquired Dauntless Air and the transaction closed on 2026-06-04
The page identifies Houlihan Lokey as Ridgewood's exclusive financial adviser and describes the Fire Boss fleet and long-term government wildfire-suppression contracts
The page does not identify the legal investee, direct holder, fund, vehicle, security, stake, control, complete seller set or rollover terms
sources.limitation: The command-line response was an Incapsula bootstrap rather than the rendered page, so the current claims were checked in the signed-in in-app browser and the bootstrap bytes were preserved and hashed.

verifiedClaims: The current adviser post says Ridgewood's acquisition was from principal shareholders Tuckerman Capital and Mainspring Capital Partners and that Macquarie Capital advised Dauntless in the sale

Principal shareholders is expressly non-exhaustive and the post does not prove the complete seller set, complete exit, management disposition or rollover, transaction capitalization or post-close owner table
Dauntless's current direct 2018 release says Aero Spray Inc. rebranded as Dauntless Air and identifies Appleton, Minnesota
The release supports one commercial platform and the Aero Spray-to-Dauntless identity transition but is not treated as proof of a statutory legal-name change or separate Dauntless entity
The current FMCSA SAFER snapshot for USDOT 1111992 identifies the legal name AERO SPRAY INC, DBA name DAUNTLESS AIR and Appleton, Minnesota physical address
The snapshot's MCS-150 form date is 2025-12-23 and therefore supports the continuing legal-name and DBA boundary after the 2018 rebrand
The current T2 SAM-derived profile identifies AERO SPRAY INC, Appleton, Minnesota, and reports Aero Spray Holding Company as ultimate parent and Aero Spray Acquisition Company as parent organization
The page reports a 2026-04-16 SAM activation date but is not a current certified legal organization chart, post-close holder record or proof of Ridgewood's acquisition structure
The returned 2020 interview identifies Brett L'Esperance as CEO and a shareholder and says Aero Spray had been owned by John Schwenk before a 2017 buyer group
The historic interview does not prove either person's 2026 ownership, disposition, rollover, stake, votes, governance or control

Ridgewood's current portfolio page includes Dauntless among Unrealized investments and describes the aerial-wildfire emergency-management infrastructure platform and long-term emergency-response contracts
The page supports current manager-platform sponsorship but is not a complete company-level direct-holder or security-holder register
